comments.story: My Passion Was My Weak Spot
comments.why: Linked as support for fair compensation argument.
comments.text: Sorry, but that's stupid... Being exploited and loving it - more sounds like an mental illness then passion. You can keep your passion - even when you get paid fairly... But enjoy your happiness in slavery, if you like. Bad thing is you hurt people who may need fair compensation (wife, kids etc. ) for their work, because you show the suits they can find people stupid enough to do so... [VIDEO]

comments.story: Yelp Fired an Employee After She Wrote a Post About Her Lousy Pay
